Is this therapy?
No, and it is not a substitute for it. If what you are carrying needs a therapist, I will say so — several people each year hear exactly that from me.
What if I miss a week?
Sessions are recorded and the thread stays open. People miss weeks; the programme is built assuming they will.
Do I have to do the exercises?
Nothing happens if you do not. That is the honest answer — the reading is the easy half and it is not the half that changes anything.
